findings.claim: All tests in the binary share one per-process temp dir, and two parallel tests both write memory.aadl (std::fs::write truncates first). A concurrent spar run can read a truncated or empty file and fail "the model must instantiate". The test is flaky, and the dir is never removed.

Targets now resolve by identity via resolve_reference, which follows dotted paths, but extract_simple_reference_name still rejects any '.' name. A dotted memory binding (reference (hw.ram)) gets no Info, and a dotted binding to a process gets no warning. No test covers a dotted target.
